listing.name: Armored Core: For Answer — Project Glintburn ACFA-Port (SulphurS16)
listing.summary: The project describes native missions, mouse input and high-frame-rate play. This review does not establish a full playthrough. See below for original-file requirements and setup. Portcove has not confirmed setup or gameplay.

steps.title: Check the required game files
steps.instruction: Use your own USA BLUS30187 disc folder, prepared with your own Sony 4.93 PUP and RPCS3. Update 01.35 PKG is optional.

steps.title: Follow upstream setup
steps.instruction: Use the release launcher to translate and compile locally. Keep the resulting game files and firmware on your computer.

warnings: The project describes native missions, mouse input and high-frame-rate play. This review does not establish a full playthrough.
Portcove has not confirmed setup, gameplay, saves or updates for this experimental port.
